The '''Levian system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Levian Two]].

==History==
An [[Battle of Levian Two|engagement]] was fought in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7.5 ABY]] between the forces of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], an ex-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]].
